findings.title: JWT signing key committed in production appsettings
findings.impact: Anyone with repository access can mint valid tokens for any user or role.
findings.remediation: Move to the host secret store, rotate the key, purge git history.

findings.title: TLS validation to SQL Server disabled in production
findings.impact: Database traffic can be intercepted by anyone on the path between the API and SQL Server.
findings.remediation: Install a trusted certificate on the SQL host and set Encrypt=True;TrustServerCertificate=False.
